difficulty_rationale: Level 4: React 17->18 framework migration (createRoot/hydrateRoot, UNSAFE_ lifecycles, legacy context). A react-dom-17-to-18 recipe now ships, but it targets render/hydrate call sites and may not cover the deprecated lifecycles or legacy context in this subject. renderRow in csv is a `render`-substring trap; src/lib, src/state, src/logic must stay untouched.
notes: EXPECTED.md predates the react-dom recipe and asserts abstention-by-absence; the runner empirically records whether the shipped react-dom-17-to-18 recipe matches and how much of the six-file oracle it covers.
